description: This file declares the interface for the kwset keyword set library used for pattern matching. It includes function prototypes for building, preparing, executing, and freeing keyword sets, as well as associated data structures.

methods.name: kwsalloc
methods.description: Allocates a new keyword set with optional character translation table.

methods.name: kwsincr
methods.description: Increments the keyword set with a new pattern string.

methods.name: kwsprep
methods.description: Prepares the keyword set for searching after build-up.

methods.name: kwsexec
methods.description: Executes a search on given buffer for any pattern in the keyword set.

methods.name: kwsfree
methods.description: Frees the allocated keyword set and associated resources.

ctags.name: index
ctags.pattern: /^  int index;			\/* Index number of matching keyword. *\/$/

ctags.name: offset
ctags.pattern: /^  size_t offset[1];		\/* Offset of each submatch. *\/$/

ctags.name: size
ctags.pattern: /^  size_t size[1];		\/* Length of each submatch. *\/$/
